chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 351 – Han Li’s Evacuation Calculus
chapter_meta_description: The sect evacuates, but Han Li runs a different calculation. A rare chance to slip away—or a trap that costs him everything?
og_description: Han Li faces a brutal choice: follow the sect to a foreign land or use the chaos as his escape route.
twitter_description: Han Li is named to the blocking team—and sees his way out. Chapter 351 of A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare physical concentration of spiritual qi that takes tens of thousands of years to form; meditating near one accelerates cultivation by 20–30%.
The second major cultivation stage; allows cultivators to live for ~200 years and use advanced artifacts; the minimum threshold for being considered a “true cultivator” in the sect hierarchy.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li destroy his own Spirit Eye Spring?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he cannot relocate it; denying the resource to the demonic path is better than letting them use it. In the Mortal Stream, resource denial is a standard tactical move.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Han Li just flee immediately when the blocking team is formed?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Patriarch’s divine sense may still be monitoring him—any suspicious move could trigger a death sentence. He must wait for the chaos of battle or a genuine opportunity to slip away without being observed.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a "Core Formation window" and why is it so important?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A cultivator’s chance of forming a Golden Core is time-limited; if they exceed a certain age or let too many years pass without a breakthrough, the opportunity is lost forever. Han Li fears that years of sect-rebuilding work will kill his window.
